div.div:
Legend
AWS service tiles: pinned draw.io AWS4 icons.
White box: custom container. Actor glyph: person.
Outlined groups: deployment node or system boundary.
Solid: main call. Dashed: auxiliary policy query.
Bold relationship: failure response. Arrows: caller to callee.

text.tspan: AWS service tiles: pinned draw.io AWS4 icons.
White box: custom container. Actor glyph: person.
Outlined groups: deployment node or system boundary.
Solid: main call. Dashed: auxiliary policy query.
Bold relationship: failure response. Arrows: caller to callee.
